text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Isn't that...
Dummy text.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She looks busy... I wonder if something 
happened? I hope she isn't pushing herself 
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the other day! 
Actually, after that, I went around asking 
all sorts of horse girls for their ideas!

The other day... she must mean the "game 
without winners or losers." I answered 
without really getting it back then, but—

When I asked for details, it turned out 
her goal was to let Maruzensky, who always 
worries about those around her, play 
without holding back.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to test them out, so please give 
me your honest feedback! First up—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Shadows exist in every era, in every 
place. Ya get me?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Hide-and-seek on the turf. A dark game 
passed down from ancient times! Nothing is 
impossible! Become the turf itself!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Trainer-san!! Can you find 
me!?

...Her head is clearly visible. She has a 
turf-like cloak draped over her shoulders, 
but naturally, she's completely in plain 
sight.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I can't become the turf... "A horse 
girl may run, but become turf she cannot," 
as they say...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Games ain't worth nothin' without thrills. 
Whoever grabs "luck" wins—that's true 
"equality," right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No cheats, settle it with a single card. 
Guaranteed to be the most heart-pounding 
game ever!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer-san, it's your turn!!

We invited other horse girls to play Old 
Maid and Doubt, but Sakura Chiyono O wore 
every emotion on her face and lost every 
single round...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No way~!? Aren't you all way too strong!? 
Is this what they call "no mask falls from 
a true champion"...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about guessing the brand 
of tea?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
One might make a mistake, but there is no 
need to decide winners and losers. I am 
certain it would make for a wonderful time 
desu_wa.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um... First I need to memorize the teas, 
right! The flavors and aromas... Alright, 
let's begin!

Sakura Chiyono O gulped down cup after 
cup, trying to memorize the brands. 
However, the sheer volume was far too 
overwhelming—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't drink any more... And this game 
was the top candidate, too... "Too much 
tea turns to stone"... *urp*...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... My stomach has settled down. I 
just got way too desperate...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A game without winners and losers... is 
really difficult after all, desu_ne. If it 
were a solo activity, that would be one 
thing, but...
choice_data_list: What are you good at, Chiyono O?

text_block_list.text:
For example, wouldn't it be worth looking 
into things Sakura Chiyono O is good at or 
enjoys?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Things I like... good at... Karuta, 
Hyakunin Isshu, and my dad taught me shiko 
stomps and teppo thrusts when I was a 
kid...
choice_data_list:
Teppo... like festival shooting gallery 
games?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, not that. Teppo refers to sumo—...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone wins... shooting gallery... 
festival...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ! This is great!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>! There are lots of things to prepare, and 
I'll need helpers, but it seems totally 
doable! I... I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right~! Let's do this~! Once it's 
ready, I'll invite you too, Trainer-san! 
Chiyono—Ohh!!

...It seemed she had come up with an idea. 
With sparkling eyes, Sakura Chiyono O 
raised her hand high into the air.
